messages.text: Run `pnpm typecheck` after 5-frontend-owner-home (wave 10) removes the HomeTrendPoint/trend usage in OwnerHome.tsx and retires ScoreTrend.tsx; it is expected to exit 1 until then. Unit verification for this unit is not affected.
